messages.offlineProtection.explainerLead: Tokom smjene kontrolna tabla ili kuhinjski ekran (KDS) moraju biti uključeni i online.
messages.offlineProtection.reminder: ⚠️ Tokom smjene držite kontrolnu tablu ili kuhinjski ekran (KDS) uključenim i online, inače offline zaštita može preuzeti.
messages.settingsCopy.orderReady.help: Prikazuje dugme „Označi kao spremno“ na ekranu narudžbi. Kuhinjski ekrani (KDS) postavljaju se zasebno, na svakom uređaju. Kupci dobiju e-mail svaki put kada je narudžba označena kao spremna. Važi za sve događaje — i dalje ga možete uključiti ili isključiti za pojedinačni događaj na njegovoj kontrolnoj tabli.
messages.manageSettings.removeVan.removedLink: ✕ Uklonjeno: Link kuhinjskog ekrana (KDS) i postavke ovog vozila bit će deaktivirani.
messages.printing.card.bluetoothUnsupported: Za štampanje je potrebna aplikacija HatchGrab — web pretraživač ne može pristupiti Bluetooth štampaču.
messages.errorsManage.wp_font_not_served: Učitani font se ne šalje web pretraživaču.
messages.managePayments.keyMismatch.body: Server ove stranice koristi {server, select, live {produkcijski} other {testni}} Stripe ključ, a verzija za web pretraživač je napravljena s ključem koji je {browser, select, live {produkcijski} other {testni}}. Plaćanje karticom ne bi uspjelo u trenutku kada kupac pokuša platiti, pa je postavljanje Stripea blokirano dok se ključevi ne podudaraju.
messages.manageWhatsApp.card.popupInstruction: Otvorit će se Facebook prozor za povezivanje vašeg WhatsApp Business računa. Ako se ništa ne pojavi, dozvolite skočne prozore za hatchgrab.com u web pretraživaču, a zatim ponovo pritisnite „Postavi“.
messages.privateEvents.noSinglePost: Privatni događaji nemaju zasebnu objavu — na vašem sedmičnom plakatu prikazuju se kao „Privatni događaj“.
messages.serviceSettings.sameSettingsConfirm: Kopirati postavke vozila „Vozilo 1“ na sva vozila? Kopiraju se sve postavke tog vozila, isto kao opcija „Isto kao: Vozilo 1“ u Postavkama. Kapacitet kuhinje ima svoj prekidač.

back.offlineProtection.explainerLead: During service the dashboard or kitchen screen must be on and online.
back.offlineProtection.reminder: ⚠️ During service keep the dashboard or kitchen screen on and online, otherwise offline protection may take over.
back.settingsCopy.orderReady.help: Shows a “Mark as ready” button on the orders screen. Kitchen screens are set separately, on each device. Customers get an email every time an order is marked ready. Applies to all events — you can still turn it on or off for a single event on its dashboard.
back.manageSettings.removeVan.removedLink: ✕ Removed: This vehicle’s kitchen screen link and settings will be deactivated.
back.printing.card.bluetoothUnsupported: Printing needs the HatchGrab app — a web browser cannot reach a Bluetooth printer.
back.errorsManage.wp_font_not_served: The uploaded font is not sent to the browser.
back.managePayments.keyMismatch.body: This site’s server uses a {server, select, live {live} other {test}} Stripe key, while the browser version was built with a key that is {browser, select, live {live} other {test}}. Card payment would fail at the moment a customer tries to pay, so setting up Stripe is blocked until the keys match.
back.manageWhatsApp.card.popupInstruction: A Facebook window will open to connect your WhatsApp Business account. If nothing appears, allow pop-ups for hatchgrab.com in your browser, then press “Set up” again.
back.privateEvents.noSinglePost: Private events do not get a separate post — they are shown on your weekly poster as “Private event”.
back.serviceSettings.sameSettingsConfirm: Copy the settings of vehicle “Vehicle 1” to all vehicles? All that vehicle’s settings are copied, the same as the option “Same as: Vehicle 1” in Settings. Kitchen capacity has its own switch.
